title: E2: Git Scanning & Coverage
description:
Git ingestion, incremental scanning, and coverage tracking.

## Scope
- Selected branch resolution (§7.1)
- O(1) fast path (HEAD unchanged check) (§7.4)
- Incremental DAG delta scan (§7.2, §7.4)
- Coverage tracking (coverage_since_utc) (§7.2)
- Rewrite detection (§7.2)
- Shallow clone handling (§7.2)
- Deterministic `until` freezing (§7.4)

## Definition of Done
- Default branch auto-detected (origin/HEAD → main → master)
- Fast path skips scan when HEAD unchanged (<15ms)
- Incremental scan processes only new commits
- Coverage persisted in meta table
- Rewrite detected and cache_valid/coverage_valid set false
- Shallow repos detected and surfaced in doctor/NDJSON
- `until` frozen once per invocation

## Dependencies
- Depends on E1 (SQLite cache must exist)

## Parallelization
Tasks are sequential (core scan logic must be built incrementally)

title: T4.2: RATE, COVERAGE, NO_EVENTS output
description:
Implement RATE line, conditional COVERAGE, and NO_EVENTS activation block.

## Specification Reference
- §10.1.4 RATE line
- §10.1.5 Coverage line
- §10.1.6 NO_EVENTS activation block

## Implementation
RATE line (always):
RATE events_per_100_commits=<x> events=<e> commits=<c>
- commits = commits in ranking window on selected branch
- events = signals with evidence_time in window, confidence >= threshold

COVERAGE line (only when incomplete or invalid):
COVERAGE status=<complete|incomplete|invalid> coverage_since_utc=<ts> coverage_valid=<0|1>
- If incomplete: NEXT: regret --scan --since <window>
- If invalid: NEXT: regret --scan --all

NO_EVENTS block (when zero events):
NO_EVENTS reverts_detected=<n> linked_fix_trailers=<n> coverage_days=<n>
REASON: coverage_incomplete | no_signals_detected | signals_outside_window
NEXT: (appropriate command)

## Definition of Done
- [ ] RATE calculation correct
- [ ] COVERAGE shown only when needed
- [ ] NO_EVENTS with differentiated REASON
- [ ] NEXT commands are exact and correct
- [ ] Exit 0 for all cases

## Test Cases
- Normal: RATE shown, no COVERAGE
- Incomplete coverage: COVERAGE with NEXT
- Invalid cache: COVERAGE status=invalid
- Zero events: full activation block

## Dependencies
Depends on T4.1 (output framework)

title: T3.2: Patch-ID computation
description:
Implement git-compatible patch-id computation.

## Specification Reference
- §8.2 B) Patch-ID computation (git-compatible)

## Implementation
Use git's patch-id --stable algorithm:
- Preferred: shell out to git patch-id --stable (batched)
- Alternative: reimplement in Rust if perf requires

Normalization rules:
- CRLF → LF (critical for cross-platform)
- Strip whitespace-only changes
- Ignore diff context line counts
- Hash only +/- content lines with file paths

Storage:
- 40-hex SHA-1 stored as 20 bytes in commit.patch_id
- Also compute patch_id_rev (reverse diff)

## Definition of Done
- [ ] patch_id computation function
- [ ] patch_id_rev (reverse) computation
- [ ] CRLF normalization
- [ ] Matches git patch-id --stable output
- [ ] Stored as 20 bytes in DB
- [ ] Computed lazily (only when needed)

## Test Cases
- Simple diff: matches git patch-id output
- CRLF in diff: normalized, same result
- Reverse diff: patch_id_rev computed
- Cached: not recomputed

## Dependencies
Depends on T2.3 (needs diff access)

title: T6.5: Advisory commit-msg hook
description:
Create advisory commit-msg hook that never blocks.

## Specification Reference
- §14.5 Pre-Commit/Commit-Msg Hooks (Advisory Only)

## Implementation
File: .regret/hooks/commit-msg

Behavior:
- NEVER blocks commits (always exit 0)
- Prints one-line hint when message contains "Fixes" but no Fixes-Commit trailer
- Silent otherwise

Script (POSIX sh):
#!/bin/sh
# regret advisory hook - never blocks
if grep -qi "fixes" "\$1" && ! grep -qE "^Fixes-(Commit|SHA):" "\$1"; then
  echo "hint: message mentions 'Fixes' - consider adding Fixes-Commit: <sha> trailer"
fi
exit 0

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Hook script created by --init
- [ ] Always exits 0
- [ ] Hint shown for missing trailer
- [ ] Silent when trailer present
- [ ] POSIX sh compatible

## Test Cases
- Message with "Fixes" no trailer: hint shown
- Message with Fixes-Commit: silent
- Message without Fixes: silent
- Always exits 0

## Dependencies

title: T5.3: Hotspot detection
description:

Hotspot requirements:
- min_events >= 2 (default, config-file only)
- min_culprits >= 2 (default, config-file only)

1. Group signals by file path (from filesets)

title: T3.3: Patch-ID revert matching
description:
Match manual reverts via patch-id equivalence.

## Specification Reference
- §8.2 A, C, D, E, G (full algorithm)

## Implementation
A) Evidence candidates:
- Commits with SUBJECT containing "revert" or "rollback"
- ASCII case-insensitive byte scan

C) Matching rule:
- patch_id(E) == patch_id_rev(C)
- Use first-parent diff (or empty tree for root)

D) Search bounds:
- C.time_utc <= E.time_utc
- C.time_utc >= coverage_since_utc
- Time bucket index to avoid O(N²)

E) Collision resolution:
- Multiple culprits: choose max(C.time_utc), tie-break lexical SHA
- One culprit, multiple evidence: emit one signal per evidence

G) Emit:
- confidence = 0.90
- confidence_reason = patch_id_equivalence

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Subject scan for revert/rollback
- [ ] Patch-ID matching with reverse
- [ ] Time-bounded search
- [ ] Collision resolution per spec
- [ ] Signal emitted with confidence=0.90
- [ ] Cached patch_ids reused

- coverage_valid: boolean (false on rewrite)

Backfill logic (--scan --since):
- Extend coverage_since_utc backward
- Only scan [requested_since, current_coverage_since)
- Do NOT rescan already-covered commits

Expose coverage:
- In NDJSON meta record
- In human output only when incomplete

## Definition of Done
- [ ] coverage_since_utc tracked
- [ ] Backfill extends coverage correctly
- [ ] No rescan of covered commits
- [ ] Coverage exposed in NDJSON
- [ ] Human output shows coverage when incomplete

## Test Cases
- First scan: coverage = bootstrap_since
- Backfill: extends coverage, scans only new range
- Coverage complete: no coverage line in output
- Coverage incomplete: coverage line shown

## Dependencies
Depends on T2.3 (scan provides coverage data)

title: T1.2: Mode precedence logic
description:
Implement mode precedence to determine which code path runs.

## Specification Reference
- §4.2 Mode Precedence (No Ambiguity)

## Implementation
Order of precedence:
1. --init: install templates/snippets; ignore id and ranking flags
2. --doctor: read-only diagnostics; ignore id and ranking flags
3. --scan: scan-only; ignore id; do not print rankings
4. sha:<sha> present: explain mode for culprit
5. default: incremental scan + ranking

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Mode enum: Init, Doctor, Scan, Explain, Default
- [ ] Precedence resolution function
- [ ] Conflicting flags resolved by precedence (no error)
- [ ] Mode determines which handler runs

- `regret --init --doctor` → runs init (init wins)
- `regret --doctor sha:abc123` → runs doctor (doctor wins)
- `regret sha:abc123 --scan` → runs scan (scan wins over explain)
- `regret sha:abc123` → runs explain
- `regret` → runs default

title: T2.7: Deterministic until freezing
description:
Freeze 'until' timestamp once per invocation for determinism.

## Specification Reference
- §7.4 Deterministic until (frozen once)

## Implementation
Compute 'until' exactly once:
1. If --until provided: use it
2. Else if GITHUB_ACTIONS=true: use HEAD committer time
3. Else: wall-clock now() at program start

Propagate to:
- Ranking queries
- Rate calculations
- Coverage completeness check
- Output rendering
- --fail-if evaluation

NDJSON must include:
- meta.window_until_utc
- meta.window_until_source (flag|github_actions_head_committer_time|wall_clock)

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Three sources: flag, CI, wall-clock
- [ ] Propagated everywhere
- [ ] window_until_source in NDJSON
- [ ] Deterministic across all outputs

- GITHUB_ACTIONS=true: uses HEAD time
- Default: uses wall-clock
- All outputs use same until value
